finding.detail: v0.3.8 keeps generic specialized receipts from closing VAJRA branches, while distinguishing completion of a bounded counterexample search from certainty about the target claim. A no-counterexample return closes only when it explicitly states bounded scope/coverage and explicitly disclaims proof; the relation channel remains neutral and the resolution is marked BOUNDED_NULL rather than SUPPORTS.

gut.summarySample: [CONTRADICTION->VAJRA] 主動尋找最小反例與破壞條件 · [CONTRADICTION->VAJRA] 主動尋找最小反例與破壞條件：針對本輪 EMPIRICAL 命題，哪個前提最可能先失效？ · [QUESTION->SHROOMING] Resolution means the handoff contract received a matching clause-scoped, executed, provenance-bearing and minimally substantive return with no detected opposing qualifying receipt in the same application. Replay identity normalize

boundary: PASS certifies only bounded lexical/structural anti-false-certainty, provenance-topology, lens-specific adequacy, and BOUNDED_NULL work-contract semantics plus a GUT regression. BOUNDED_NULL is not evidence that a claim is true, and no search completeness beyond the declared scope is certified.
